finding_dispositions: ISBN and trial-registration identifiers are candidate signals rather than automatic report duplicates, with false-merge regression coverage.
Study membership and ReportOfStudy edges remain consistent across detach, merge and split operations with operation-specific evidence validation.
Large-collection token blocking is complete over the supported positive-Jaccard threshold domain, with high-similarity and 64/65 boundary regressions.
BibTeX and EndNote importers quarantine unconsumed or unterminated input and preserve compact or same-line multiple records.
The study-linkage fixture executes all declared metrics and rejects unknown, omitted, ambiguous or assigned-and-abstained report coverage.
Detaching the sole report is explicitly rejected without graph mutation.
Title similarity thresholds reject zero, negative, above-one, NaN and infinite values; one remains supported.
